result.topic_en: Saddle-point (Riemann–Siegel) evaluation of the contour integral of e^{-nx}x^{s-1}/(e^x-1) on the critical line, yielding the main sum of cos(θ - t log n)/√n plus a correction term involving cos(2(β²-β)π - π/8)/cos 2βπ.
result.transcription:
$\int_0^\infty \frac{e^{-mx}x^{s-1}}{e^x-1}dx$ \quad $s-1=ti-\frac12$
$-t\frac{x^2}{2\pi i}-\frac12$
$[-...-]\log(y+\alpha) = (s-1)\log\alpha+\frac{y}{\alpha}-\frac{y^2}{2\alpha^2}+\frac{y^3}{3\alpha^3}-\frac{y^4}{4\alpha^4}$
$-\frac{ti}{2\alpha^2}=-\frac{1}{4\pi i}$
$\alpha^2=-2\pi t$
$e^{(\frac{\alpha^2}{2\pi i}-\frac12)(\log\alpha+\frac{\alpha y}{\pi i}-\frac{y^2}{4\pi i}+\frac{1}{\alpha}(-\frac12 y+\frac{y^3}{6\pi i})+\frac{1}{\alpha^2}(\frac14 y^2-\frac{y^4}{8\pi i})}$
$x=z+m2\pi i$
$y=z-\alpha+m2\pi i$
$2\pi i(\frac{\alpha}{2\pi i}-m)^2=\frac{\alpha\alpha}{2\pi i}-2m\alpha+mm2\pi i$
$-\frac{zz}{4\pi i}+2(\frac{\alpha}{2\pi i}-m)z+2m\alpha-\frac34\frac{\alpha\alpha}{\pi i}-mm\pi i$
$-2\beta[?]\pi i\beta[?]-\frac14\frac{\alpha\alpha}{\pi i}-mm\pi i$
$Q=\int\frac{e^{2\beta z-\frac{zz}{4\pi i}}}{e^z-1}dz$
$=\int\frac{e^{2\beta y-\frac{yy}{4\pi i}+4\beta\pi i-y-\pi i}}{e^y-1}dy+2\pi i\,e^{4\beta\pi i-\pi i}$
$Q(1+e^{-4\beta\pi i})=\int e^{(2\beta-1)y-\frac{yy}{4\pi i}}dy-2\pi i=-2\pi i+e^{(2\beta-1)^2\pi i}\cdot2\pi\cdot e^{\frac{\pi}{4}i}$
$[-...-]2\sqrt{\pi}\,e^{\frac{\pi}{4}i}=y-2\pi i(2\beta-1)$
$Q\,2\cos2\beta\pi\,e^{-2\beta\pi i}=2\pi i\left(e^{(2\beta-1)^2\pi i-\frac{\pi}{4}i}-1\right)$ \quad $\beta=\delta+\frac12$ \quad $4Q\,2\cos2\delta\pi\,e^{-2\delta\pi i}=2\pi i\,e^{4\delta^2\pi i-\frac{\pi}{4}i}-1$
$2\pi i\cos(2\delta^2\pi+\frac38\pi)\,e^{2\delta^2\pi i-\frac58\pi i}$
$\frac{1}{2\pi}Q\,e^{-2\delta\pi i-2\delta^2\pi i+\frac58\pi i}=\frac{\cos(2\delta^2\pi+\frac38\pi)}{\cos2\delta\pi}=\frac{1}{2\pi}e^{\frac58\pi i}\int\frac{e^{z-\frac{zz}{4\pi i}}}{e^z-1}e^{-2\delta^2\pi i-2\delta\pi i+2\delta z}dz$
$-(2\pi i)(\delta+\frac12-\frac{z}{2\pi i})^2$
$=-2\pi i(\delta^2+\delta)+z(2\delta+1)-\frac{zz}{2\pi i}$
$-\frac12\pi i$
$\frac{\cos(2\delta^2\pi+\frac38\pi)}{\cos2\delta\pi}=\int\frac{e^{+\frac{zz}{4\pi i}}}{e^z-1}e^{-2\pi i(\delta+\frac12-\frac{z}{2\pi i})^2}dz\,\frac{1}{2\pi}e^{\frac58\pi i}$
$\beta=\frac{\alpha}{2\pi i}-m=\sqrt{\frac{t}{2\pi}}-m$
$\Pi(s-1)\,\pi^{-\frac{s}{2}}\ldots=\int_\infty^0\frac{e^{-x}-e^{-2x}}{\ldots}x^{s-1}dx$
$=2\pi\sum\ldots(n\pi i)^{s-1}$
$x=n\pi i$
$\frac{\sin2(\delta^2-\ldots)\pi}{\cos2\delta\pi}$
$\delta=n\pm\frac14$
$n^2\pm\frac12n$
$\sin(2n\pm1)n\pi$
$(2\pi i)^{1-s}$
$(1-s)\log(2\pi i)-ti+(s-1)\log(\sqrt{t}\ldots i)+\frac{ti}{2}-mm\pi i=$
$(\frac{s-1}{2})\log(\frac{t}{2\pi})$
$-\frac14\log\frac{t}{2\pi}+\frac{\pi}{8}i-mm\pi i$
$+e^{-\frac14\log\frac{t}{2\pi}}e^{(\ldots-mm)\pi i}\frac{\cos((\beta\beta-\beta)2\pi-\frac{\pi}{8})}{\cos2\beta\pi}$
$+2\sum_1^m\frac{\cos(\theta-\log n\,t)}{\sqrt n}$ \quad $\beta=\sqrt{\frac{t}{2\pi}}-m$
$\gamma=\sqrt{\frac{t}{2\pi}}-m-\frac12$
$\sum_1^m\frac{\cos(\theta-t\log n)}{\sqrt n}+(-1)^{m}\frac{\cos(\gamma\gamma2\pi+\frac38\pi)}{2\sqrt[4]{\frac{t}{2\pi}}\cos2\gamma\pi}$
$\frac{t}{2}=\frac{9}{2}\pi$

Evaluation of the basic integral Q via shift of contour and Gaussian (Fresnel) integral
